roads.name: Station Road to Pandri Market Link

defects.description: Exposed open drain slab on northern carriageway pedestrian verge. Severe hazard for pedestrians & two-wheelers.
Extensive water logging (>15cm depth) adjacent to carriageway due to blocked curb drainage inlet.
Unauthorized commercial kiosk built directly over primary storm water drain box culvert.

defects.road_name: Station Road to Pandri Market Link
defects.description: Cast-iron manhole cover fractured and depressed by 80mm beneath road surface profile.
Manhole cover completely missing in narrow internal street; temporary wooden log placed inside as warning.
Precast RCC drain cover slab intact, properly aligned with curb line and unblocked silt grating.
Deep pothole (diameter 1.2m, depth 95mm) in fast lane causing sudden vehicular swerving.
Displaced concrete kerb stone edging and damaged tactile paving on pedestrian pathway.
Retro-reflective speed limit (60 km/h) gantry sign bent due to storm wind, partially obstructed.
Thermoplastic pedestrian zebra crossing and lane divider markings completely faded (>70% loss).

defects.road_name: Station Road to Pandri Market Link
defects.description: Twin LED street luminaire pole unlit; exposed wiring junction box at base presenting electrocution hazard.
Construction debris dumping encroaching on roadway edge and blocking roadside drainage flow.
